businessMeaning: Provide employee certificate request and HR certificate/document metadata workbenches through one People-owned request-and-issue command, durable immutable metadata and a minimized CertificateIssued.v1 event. Stage A intentionally excludes document delivery, revocation and access/download audit implementation while preserving expiry and access/download audit as mandatory later full-slice acceptance boundaries; Stage A receives zero full-slice completion credit.

V54 owns the generic immutable command-receipt lifecycle and V51 owns current product authorization.
sys_people_audit_events and sys_people_outbox_events are the existing audit and semantic-event stores.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: IAQ-003 and IAQ-010 expose only their exact accepted GET browser and owner paths, page limit, stable ordering, deep links, metadata field groups and action allowlists.
Both projections enforce COMPLETE, EMPTY, PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE cardinality, freshness, typed partial failure, cursor scope/revision and VIEW, MASK or OMIT field-decision invariants.
PEP-HRM-012 accepts only the five sealed request fields and required command headers, rejects unknown fields and returns the durable 202 CommandReceiptV1 contract.

The owner deterministically chooses self or operations authority from trusted actor-person identity and personPublicId, enforces the exact duty, purpose, population and field groups and requires common HIGH step-up before mutation; TEAM_MANAGEMENT is negatively asserted as DENY/DEFER with no team profile and no fallback.
The tenant, command type and idempotency-key scope serializes concurrent reservation; same-hash replay returns the original receipt and different-hash reuse returns 409 without another side effect.

People V58 creates exactly the two certificate metadata tables, blueprint constraints, queue and receipt indexes, forced tenant RLS policies and immutable transition guards with no second migration or historical edit.

A successful issue freezes template, seal and subject inputs plus object identity and digest, then atomically commits request ISSUED, issued metadata, receipt, audit and the exact six-field CertificateIssued.v1 outbox event.

The production artifact adapter fails closed with no issued state or event while the test-only conformance double proves deterministic success, retryable failure and rollback without becoming a production binding.
No API, event, projection or UI reveals document bytes, object or download URL, verification token or hash, revoke control, download action, revoke action or invented capability.

Feature absent, false or tenant unenrolled mounts no owner runtime and sends zero calls; Platform people.employment-certificate remains read-only and no Platform request is copied, migrated or mirrored.

The two component surfaces identify primary user, operational question, primary action and list-detail or focus-form archetype and cover loading, empty, partial, unavailable, denied, stale and complete states at 1440, 1280, 390, 320, 200-percent zoom, light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion, keyboard and long Korean/English labels.
